decision.reason: [ev-1253ff5bd0a5] gives the subject and the change: NodePool expireAfter moves from spec.disruption to spec.template.spec and is now drift-able. It is bundled with an unrelated Kubelet move. The section context [ev-bfb089d90d84] only says in general terms that conversion webhooks pull the v1 version of applied v1beta1 NodePools, and that v1beta1 stops being served at v1.1.0. It points to the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure, which is not shown. Nothing says whether an existing spec.disruption.expireAfter is converted to the new path, or whether the conversion, or making the field drift-able, causes drift and node replacement on upgrade (drift can no longer be disabled per [ev-13278d059ceb]). That missing statement is the consequence for an operator who does nothing.
